title: Launchpad template buy fee, buyTotalFees()
detects: The total fee taken on a buy, from the ERC-20 template most launchpad tokens share, in whatever unit the template uses. Read as a value: 0 is absent, above 0 is present with the rate. This reads the fee being taken, not who can change it; the setters are in the gap scanner's table.
knownFalseNegative: A live owner with the fee set to 0 today reads as absent; the gap scan reports the setter so the capability is not silently clean. A template with a differently named getter reads as absent.

coversExamples.observed: buyTotalFees() answers 0 and owner() answers the zero address: fee machinery present, no fee taken, nobody left who can change it

rationale: Five of 40 actively traded tokens launched in the 90 days before 2026-09-06 share this template byte for byte and answer this getter. Without this file a launch-week token taking a fee on every buy reads fee control absent on the exit axis, and the axis a holder reads to know what leaving costs says 0.
